subject.title: fix(ui): preserve agent, session, locale, and dashboard ownership

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR land as one coordinated Control UI ownership fix, or should any of its five linked bug fixes be split into narrower follow-up PRs?
rationale: The patch deliberately combines related but distinct UI ownership corrections, and the repository’s protected maintainer signal requires an explicit human judgment on scope even though no concrete defect is established here.
